== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|A cutlass is a type of sword used by [[Calder]], appearing similar in shape to the dueling sabers he practiced with during his childhood. While some versions of the weapon are described as mundane metal, [[Calder]] possesses an [[Awakened cutlass]] that is unique. This specific blade features a long, black surface mottled with shifting orange spots that resemble the patterns of hot coals. This Awakened weapon is significantly heavier than standard swords and can be infused with a user's [[Intent]] to provide a combat advantage. A highly significant and ancient cutlass exists that predates [[The Empire{{!}}the Empire]] and its Emperor, potentially sharing an age with a great monster. This unique blade has been used by generations of [[Consultants]] and assassins for over a thousand years to claim many important lives. It is described as having the power to break any defense, steal any power, and take any life. The weapon carries a palpable weight of [[Intent]] from its many kills and possesses a magnetic quality that guides it back into its sheath.}}
